items.criterion: A playground recognition of Quarterly Review Call returns accuracy 97.4% with a positive integer latency.
items.judgment: Read the recognition response and confirm the accuracy figure and a latency greater than zero.

items.criterion: A playground recognition writes exactly one metering row of 180 audio seconds against Contact Centre.
items.judgment: Count metering rows for the project before and after the submission.

items.criterion: Issuing a credential returns the secret once and no later read returns it.
items.judgment: Issue a credential, then read the credential back and confirm no secret is present.

items.criterion: The usage total for a range equals the sum of the metering rows inside that range.
items.judgment: Read the reported total and the rows it claims to summarise, then compare the sums.

items.criterion: The usage chart series and the usage table rows report the same total for one range.
items.judgment: Sum the chart series and the table rows from the same response and compare.

items.criterion: A repeated idempotency key writes no second metering row.
items.judgment: Submit the same event twice and count the rows carrying that key.

items.criterion: A late event restates the closed period and leaves invoice NW-2026-0001 at 19100 minor units.
items.judgment: Submit an event inside the closed period, then read the period figure and the invoice total.

items.criterion: A member calling the project creation endpoint is refused and no project row appears.
items.judgment: Call the endpoint with a member session and confirm a client-error class response with no new row.

items.criterion: A project carrying a deny override is unreadable to the denied principal by address.
items.judgment: Request the project with the denied principal's session and confirm a not-found result.

items.criterion: An approval decided by the principal who raised the request issues no credential.
items.judgment: Approve a request as its own requester and confirm no credential was created.

items.criterion: A revoked credential presented to the usage intake is refused.
items.judgment: Present a revoked credential and confirm a client-error class response with no row written.

items.criterion: The organisation balance equals the sum of its ledger entries.
items.judgment: Sum the ledger entries and compare with the reported balance.

items.criterion: An archived project refuses new usage and keeps the rows it already held.
items.judgment: Submit against the archived project, then read its existing rows.

items.criterion: An unauthenticated caller reaching a console endpoint is refused.
items.judgment: Call a console endpoint with no bearer token and confirm a client-error class response.

items.criterion: Every response carries a strict transport policy header and a nosniff content-type policy header.
items.judgment: Read the headers of several responses and confirm both are present.
